# jenius Systems

> A one-operator AI-systems studio: one human sets direction, a fleet of AI agents designs,
> builds, tests, and reviews the software. Three systems are live today.

Everything listed is real and running; anything private is labeled private.

## Systems

- [Pico Park — Web Co-op](https://games.jeniussystems.ai/): a co-op party platformer played on one
  shared screen, with phones as gamepads (join by QR code). Live and free to play.
- [The Fleet — architecture sandbox](https://jeniussystems.ai/sandbox/): a sanitized architecture
  overview of the studio's self-hosted fleet of AI agents (mail, health, calendar, concierge and
  more) behind one hardened gateway.
- [BMC Development — case notes](https://jeniussystems.ai/built/): a construction-finance platform
  (PDF+OCR invoice intake, approval routing, dual budgets, draw packages). Private pilot; not
  publicly accessible.

## Notes

- The public site carries no live operational data; the fleet overview is descriptive only.
- There is nothing to sign up for and nothing for sale here.
